title: Verify that clicking Next with an empty Company Name shows the inline required message and blocks the step
description: Company Name is mandatory. The PBI states that clicking Next with a missing mandatory field shows '{Field Name} is required' under that field.

steps.action: Open the Mediation Request wizard as a public visitor via the Submit New Request CTA
steps.expected: Step 01 loads with the Next button enabled by default

steps.action: Complete every mandatory field in Step 01 except Company Name
steps.expected: All fields except Company Name hold values

steps.action: Click Next
steps.expected: The wizard does not advance and the message 'Company Name is required' appears directly under the Company Name field

steps.action: Inspect the form and the step indicator
steps.expected: The wizard is still on Step 01 and every other field retains the value that was entered
